props.gloss_en: the mishna (cited): [if] the tail was damaged from the bone, etc. [is a blemish]
a tanna taught: the fingerbreadth they spoke of is one of four in the handbreadth of any person
Rabba: [it is said] with regard to tekhelet
how many strings does one put? Beit Shammai: four
and how much should be hanging? Beit Shammai: four
the baraita: and the three of which Beit Hillel speak -- [each] one of four in the handbreadth of any person
Rav Huna son of R' Yehoshua: [it is said] for the two cubits
the mishna: there were two cubits in Shushan HaBira, one on the north-eastern corner and one on the south-eastern corner
the one on the north-eastern corner exceeded Moses' [cubit] by half a fingerbreadth
the one on the south-eastern corner exceeded it by half a fingerbreadth; it is found to exceed Moses' by a fingerbreadth
why was one large and one small? so that the craftsmen would take by the small and return by the large, that they not come to misuse of consecrated property
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak, and some say Rav Huna bar Natan: [it is said] for that which we learned: where there is flesh between vertebra and vertebra a full fingerbreadth
